name: sb_switch_and_flush_buffer
desc: Flush/start playback of the current audio buffer and switch to the alternate ping-pong buffer
details: Waits in a spin loop until any ongoing Sound Blaster playback finishes (CS:[0019h] == 0). If the current buffer length in BX is non-zero, it triggers playback of the filled buffer via sb_play_sound_buffer (0823:0F49). It then resets BX to 0 and toggles the active double-buffer ID (CS:[001Ch]) between 1 and 2, returning the offset of the new buffer (0x001F or 0x061F) in DI.

params.name: bytes_to_play
params.desc: Number of bytes filled in current buffer (0 to 0x600)

params.name: current_buffer_offset
params.desc: Offset of current audio buffer in CS segment

ret.name: next_buffer_offset
ret.desc: Offset of next audio buffer to fill (0x001F or 0x061F)

0823:101f.comment: Check which buffer was active; toggle to the other

0823:101c.comment: Reset write offset to 0 for next buffer
0823:101c.label: switch_buffers

0823:1014.comment: If buffer has bytes to play (BX > 0), trigger playback

0823:100c.comment: Spin-wait until previous DMA playback completes (is_playing == 0)
0823:100c.label: wait_playback_idle
